currentContext.strategies: AI-first strategy: embed AI across operations, platforms and customer experiences, with Google Gemini Enterprise AI rolled out across the organization so teams can build intelligent agents and drive innovation at scale.|Continue innovating in the AI space and develop intelligent AI Agents that deliver contextual and autonomous support across business functions.|Evolve the flagship FINATO platform for Finance Transformation into an AI-first, agentic platform designed to enable autonomous finance operations.|Scale TruAI Underwriting, the agentic AI solution launched for complex, decision-intensive processes in the insurance sector, which management says is already seeing strong market traction.|Focus for the current fiscal year on artificial intelligence, talent development, expansion in key international markets, and investments in technology and research.|Align solutions more closely with Banking & Financial Services, Insurance, Manufacturing and Logistics, combining deep domain expertise with next-generation technologies to address sector-specific challenges.|Keep investing in the Digital Content platform that came with the recent acquisition, strengthening it with AI so enterprises can rapidly scale.|ESG agenda: formally committed to setting Science Based Targets, with Scope 3 inventorization near completion and GHG reduction targets to be submitted for SBTi validation in FY 2026-27; a cross-functional ESG Committee oversees strategy; pursue the EcoVadis 'Committed' badge and publish an independent sustainability report once sustainability targets are approved.
currentContext.expansion: Datamatics is an asset-light IT services / BPM business and the routed sections carry no plant, capacity or rupee-capex programme. Expansion in this annual report is described entirely as market footprint, platform build-out and inorganic addition. Management states it will focus in the current fiscal year on artificial intelligence, talent development, expansion in key international markets, and investments in technology and research. Google Gemini Enterprise AI has been rolled out across the organization so teams can build intelligent agents at scale; the Digital Technologies business is built around the proprietary KAi suite (KAiBRE, KAiSDLC, KAiTest, KAiData); the flagship FINATO platform for Finance Transformation is being re-engineered into an AI-first, agentic platform designed to enable autonomous finance operations; and TruAI Underwriting was launched for decision-intensive processes in the insurance sector. In the Digital Content business, a recent acquisition brought in a platform that substantially streamlines workflows, and the company says it continues to invest in strengthening that platform with AI. No commissioning dates, capacity additions, site names or capex quantum appear anywhere in this bundle.

risks.note: The BRSR material-issues table flags this as a significant risk for BPM and IT companies given the highly competitive nature of the industry and the demand for specialized skills, with high turnover driven by job dissatisfaction, lack of career growth opportunities and inadequate compensation and benefits. Mitigation is professional development and education plus a diverse and inclusive workforce culture.

BPM work involves complex, high-volume workloads and a high-stress work environment; extended sitting leads to a sedentary lifestyle and health problems, and employees sometimes experience mental health issues such as anxiety, depression and stress from workload pressure. Company response is safety protocols, access to healthcare resources and healthy-lifestyle promotion.

Data centers and other IT infrastructure consume heavily; the company flags vulnerability to disruptions in the energy supply chain such as power outages or fuel shortages that can impact the availability and reliability of its IT systems, plus environmental regulations restricting energy consumption whose breach can result in fines and other penalties. Mitigation is green technologies such as cloud and third-party renewable energy.

Operating data centers and electronic devices is an energy-intensive activity generating significant direct and indirect greenhouse gas emissions; uncontrolled pollutants and emissions impose legal and environmental risks on the company. Mitigated by leveraging cloud and other Green IT technologies and energy-efficient lighting.

A poor customer experience relationship can pose a risk of loss of existing customers or decrease in customer loyalty, and loss of customers plus damage to reputation can lead to a decline in sales and revenue. The organization tracks customer satisfaction through metrics and data to identify areas of improvement.

Delivery quality is the competitive lever in BPM: failure to standardise processes and to meet or exceed customer expectations erodes the differentiator that builds customer loyalty and revenue. The company relies on process standardisation, automation, process mapping and continuous improvement to hold consistency and timeliness.

risks.risk: Exposure to an uneven global macro recovery
risks.note: Management explicitly acknowledges the uncertainties of an uneven global recovery in the CEO message, and the business is levered to global enterprise technology spending across the outsourced IT services, business process services and digital content markets whose growth rates the Chairman cites as the demand backdrop.

Risk management runs through a board-level Risk Management Committee constituted under SEBI LODR with a formal Risk Management Policy, and the Audit Committee holds additional oversight of financial risks and controls. The Secretarial Audit Report's only adverse remark for FY 2025-26 was a delay of 5 days in holding the Risk Management Committee Meeting, which management has noted and undertaken to remedy.

themes.title: AI-led IT services & ER&D transformation
themes.need: Q1FY27 split the bucket three ways: a soft large-cap core, a re-accelerating mid-cap tier, and an outright business-model change. TCS grew constant currency only +0.4% QoQ / +3.2% YoY despite $9.5bn of TCV (including an ~$800mn net-new SKF mega-deal), and its AI-services book annualising $2.6bn (+13.6% QoQ) saw incremental adds DECELERATE from +$125mn to +$75mn - AI is still project revenue, not annuity. WIPRO is the laggard (+0.9% YoY cc, margin -120bps to 16.0%, Q2 guided -1.5% to +0.5%). Mid-caps are outgrowing: TECHM grew +6.6% YoY cc with every vertical up and an 11th consecutive quarter of margin expansion (14.4%, +330bps); MPHASIS's pipeline is at an all-time high, 2.8x its size at the Mphasis.ai launch and +28% YoY, with AI-led deals now 70% of it (from 12%) and BFS pipeline +100% YoY, and its new Tria platform closed multiple opportunities within seven weeks of launch; FRACTAL lifted net income +92% YoY on INR 912.5cr revenue at NRR 117% with zero churn (though only +9% cc, dragged by TMT -22%); KPITTECH won $349M of new deals with 21% of pipeline now productized AI/SDV solutions. Structurally, HCLTECH is entering the AI-datacenter business with an initial investment of up to INR 3,500cr and a 50MW long-term ambition, and PERSISTENT is buying Nagarro at EUR 1.27bn EV to build a $2.9bn / 46,000-person group - European scale is now bought, not built. The new cost line is visas: TATAELXSI crossed INR 1,000cr of quarterly revenue for the first time (INR 1,021.1cr) yet EBIT fell 330bps QoQ, with 220-230bps of it onsite/subcontractor investment the CFO said cannot be passed to customers.
themes.driver: MPHASIS's guide that 'Q2 is positioned to deliver the best sequential constant currency growth we have delivered in three years' is the most falsifiable claim in the sector; then HCLTECH's AI-datacenter build, the PERSISTENT-Nagarro close, and whether TCS's AI incremental adds re-accelerate off +$75mn.

- AI-first strategy: embed AI across operations, platforms and customer experiences, with Google Gemini Enterprise AI rolled out across the organization so teams can build intelligent agents and drive innovation at scale.
- Continue innovating in the AI space and develop intelligent AI Agents that deliver contextual and autonomous support across business functions.
- Evolve the flagship FINATO platform for Finance Transformation into an AI-first, agentic platform designed to enable autonomous finance operations.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Acquisitions] A Q4FY26 exceptional item of "₹ 40.85 crore ... represents the fair value changes of contingent consideration payable towards acquisition of subsidiaries", indicating earn-out-linked acquisitions; the deck does not name the subsidiaries.
- [Regulation] "One-time exceptional impact arising from the change in Labour Codes was (-) ₹16.23 Cr for Q4FY26. The impact has been taken considering the restructuring being undertaken in alignment with the provisions of the Labour Codes."
- [Group structure] A leadership-team entry identifies Sameer L. Kanodia as "DIRECTOR & VICE CHAIRMAN & CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER OF LUMINA DATAMATICS & VICE CHAIRMAN & CEO TNQTECH", the only reference to these group entities.
- [Deal wins] Q1FY27 wins include SBI Life Insurance selecting "Datamatics' TruAI Underwriting solution", plus unnamed clients: a global engineering solutions provider, an American pet wellness and veterinary care provider, a leading American pharmaceutical patient support organization, a leading US based consumer products company, and a renowned UK-based university.
